apple.name: Inborn: Private Local AI Chat
apple.subtitle: Offline On-Device LLM Chatbot
apple.promotional_text: Private AI chat that runs 100% on your phone. No account, no cloud, no analytics. Works in Airplane Mode. One-time purchase for Pro. Verify it yourself.
apple.description:
Inborn is an AI chat app that runs entirely on your phone. Private is not a promise on a webpage here. It is something you can check in a minute.

Turn on Airplane Mode and ask it anything. It still answers, at the same speed, because the model lives on your device. There is no server to reach.

See it for yourself:
- Airplane Mode: the chat keeps working with every radio off.
- The app opens no connection by itself. Put it behind a firewall and watch nothing appear.
- iPhone: Settings, Privacy, App Privacy Report. Inborn's row stays empty.
- Every check above happens outside the app, with no cooperation from us, and the Proof screen names the exact build you are running.

What you get, all on-device:
- Unlimited chat with open models like Qwen and Phi, or import any GGUF file (Gemma, Mistral, Llama).
- Read and ask questions about your own PDFs and documents.
- Speak to it and hear it read back, with voices that run locally.
- A screen lock, an incognito mode that saves nothing and ends with the session, and one-tap wipe.

Honest about limits: a small model on a phone is not a giant cloud model. Inborn tells you each model's name, how fast it runs on your exact device, and when a larger one would help.

There is no account. No email, no sign-in, nothing to create. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, ever. The privacy label is Data Not Collected.

Free is a complete app: full chat, no message limit, no watermark. Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription. Buy it once and keep it. One month of a cloud AI subscription, and it never renews.

Responses are generated by AI and can be wrong. Check anything that matters.

google.title: Inborn - Offline AI Chat
google.short_description: Offline AI chat that runs on your phone. No account, no cloud, nothing leaves.
google.full_description:
Inborn is an offline AI chat app. The AI model runs 100% on your phone, so it works with no internet connection: on a plane, on the subway, abroad, or with Wi-Fi off. Nothing you type ever leaves your device.

This is a private AI chatbot you can verify, not just trust:
- On Android, Inborn has no Internet permission at all. Open App permissions on this page and look: there is no full network access. The app cannot go online.
- Turn on Airplane Mode and keep chatting. Same speed, same answers.
- Every check above happens outside the app, with no cooperation from us, and the Proof screen names the exact build you are running.

Everything runs on-device:
- Unlimited offline AI chat with open local models like Qwen and Phi, or import any GGUF file (Gemma, Mistral, Llama): a local LLM in your pocket.
- Ask questions about your own PDFs and documents, offline.
- Talk to it and hear replies, with on-device voices.
- Screen lock, an incognito mode that saves nothing and ends with the session, and emergency wipe.

Honest about limits: a small on-device model is not a giant cloud model. Inborn shows each model's name, how fast it runs on your device, and when a bigger one would help.

No account. No email or sign-in. No analytics, no ads, and no data collection of any kind. The privacy label is Data Not Collected.

Free is a complete app: unlimited chat, no message quota, no watermark. Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription and no quota. Pay once, keep it forever.

Content in Inborn is generated by AI and can be inaccurate. Please verify important information.

reviewer_notes:
Inborn runs an AI model entirely on the device. There is no backend server and no user account.

TESTING OFFLINE: A small model ships inside the app, so you can start chatting immediately with no download. Turn on Airplane Mode and the chat still works at the same speed.

NETWORK: On Android the release manifest has no INTERNET permission at all (verified with aapt2 dump permissions against every release build; models are delivered by Google Play as asset packs). On iOS every network path is optional and user-initiated: installing a larger model from our own CDN at models.inbornapp.com, and, only if the tester asks for it, a Hugging Face import. The default model ships inside the app, needs no download, and the app opens no socket on its own, so those hosts appear in the App Privacy Report only while a download the tester started is running.

NO ACCOUNT: No login, email or sign-in is required for any feature.

AI CONTENT: Responses are AI-generated and are labeled as such in onboarding and on outputs. To test the report control, open any AI reply and choose Report; it works offline and transmits nothing.

PURCHASES: Pro is a single non-consumable in-app purchase. Family Sharing is not enabled for this release. The free tier is fully functional without it: unlimited chat, no message limit, no watermark.

Leading with the demand phrase 'Private AI' (App Store popularity 95) plus plain-language 'no internet' converts mainstream searchers better than the technical LLM/on-device register.
